components.name: Search Submit Button
components.description: Cobalt action in the white homepage search field.
components.css: .ds-search-button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; background: #315f8a; font: 600 14px Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color .16s ease; } .ds-search-button:hover { background: #244968; } .ds-search-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d1a56d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Homepage Search Field
components.description: White, labeled search control with an integrated submit action.
components.html: <form class="ds-search" role="search"><label class="ds-search-label" for="search">Buscar productos</label><input id="search" type="search" placeholder="Buscar un producto"><button type="submit">Buscar</button></form>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 58px; padding: 6px 7px 6px 16px; border: 1px solid #d8dee4; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; } .ds-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; height: 44px; flex: 1; border: 0; color: #1b2430; background: transparent; font: 400 15px Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #315f8a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-search button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; background: #315f8a; }

components.css: .ds-product { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #d8dee4; border-radius: 12px; color: #1b2430; background: #fff; } .ds-product-media { display: grid; height: 196px; place-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8dee4; background: #eef1f3; } .ds-product-body { display: grid; gap: 5px; padding: 15px 16px 17px; font: 400 14px/1.35 Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-product-body small { color: #315f8a; } .ds-product-body strong { font-weight: 550; } .ds-product-body b { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 16px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-product-body span { color: #216a48; font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview: AmpereStore presents a clear technology catalogue in its existing cobalt identity. The homepage guides shoppers from search or category to real products, with price in ARS and availability visible. Its blue hero frames the featured product; the rest of the catalogue stays flat and easy to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Visible ARS prices and stock labels

rules.name: Verified Claims
rules.body: Do not introduce delivery, price-leadership, compatibility, or performance promises without evidence.

rules.name: Scan First
rules.body: Keep price and availability readable and preserve real product imagery and existing routes.

dos: Do preserve the AmpereStore logo, blue identity, and current functions.
Do keep prices and stock states legible.
donts: Don't invent service or performance claims.
Don't replace product photography with invented imagery.
